Based on the provided screenshots of the kozycare.ng landing page on a 390px (iPhone 14) viewport:

*   **(a) Navigation Bar:** Yes, the top navigation bar is fully visible in Img1. It displays the "Kozy Care" logo and the "Sign in" / "Sign up" buttons clearly. The layout is clean, and the buttons appear large enough to be usable.
*   **(b) Layout & Overflow:** No horizontal overflow or broken layout is detected. All content fits within the 390px width. The header elements are properly aligned without clipping.
*   **(c) Footer Integrity:** **No**, the footer is not intact in Img2. The screenshot shows the middle of the page content ("02 · We collect & treat") rather than the bottom of the page. There is no footer visible in the second image.
*   **(d) Touch Targets:** No elements appear too small. The "Sign in" and "Sign up" buttons are generously sized with ample padding, making them comfortable to tap on a mobile device.
